crossRefs.note: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
“Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”
Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then…
Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by…
that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.
Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God…
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which…
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,

translations.web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
translations.bsb: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.”
translations.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
translations.asv: Forthwith therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God, to hear all things that have been commanded thee of the Lord.
